item.title: New traffic pattern
item.description: All northbound traffic on North Lamar must detour to Main Street through the Lamar development, then reconnect at the roundabout at Chickasaw Drive and Molly Barr Road. Northbound through traffic is not permitted in the construction zone at this time. Drivers should follow updated detour signs posted near Velvet Ditch Coffee.
